verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm, but its boilerplate says it uses legal tech and AI-based systems, and YSolutions is a software-supported service. That makes a client's ability to keep their data out of AI training a fair question. The evidence pack contains no policy, opt-out, or control on training use of client data, so the axis applies but nothing shows it is delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
